judged_text: PollFeed#import unconditionally calls i.content.scrub, but feed items without a content element will raise NoMethodError on nil, aborting the whole hourly poll. A single feed item lacking <content> (link/title-only feeds are common) makes every subsequent poll crash at i.content, so no further feed items are ever imported until the feed changes; also i.id fallback for non-http links is untested.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `poll_feed` does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` for each `rss.items`. This is unconditional; if a feed item lacks a `content` element (so `i.content` is `nil`), calling `.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError` and abort the entire hourly job. There is no nil-check or rescue around item processing, so a single such item can prevent importing subsequent items during that run.
